GROSS - REFERENCE.

SUBJECT: Karl Groehl.

On 29.4.38., Groehl wrote to Otten thanking him for the £4 and said he would arrive at Victoria on Saturday or Sunday, 6 p.m. depending on when he received the invitation.

Written in Groehl's own handwriting.
